items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: That's something that I know Bill would be interested in.

ctx.x: Nobody's had a chance to hear it, though. Uh-huh.

They tried it and that's all. They didn't like it. Too hard to learn, maybe. Yes, yes. Oh, yes, very hard. Maybe Bill could get you praying that sometimes. Why, you see? They got a gang of fellows here, come with it, give it up. You know? That's not the right type of a band to play those strings here. They have to be able to read all those. I say, can you all follow me? They say, hell no. Oh, no. I say, come on. Oh, God. No. No. Oh, God. No. Well, someday maybe you'll get to play those. You have them arranged for…
I mean, others that people do play.
